en.headline: Bar Camillo opens at Rosewood Hong Kong with Bar Leone founders
en.dek: The Italian-inspired cocktail bar begins service on 25 November at the Tsim Sha Tsui hotel, offering 50 seats indoors and on the terrace with a tableside Negroni trolley.
body: Rosewood Hong Kong said Bar Camillo, a new cocktail bar developed with Lorenzo Antinori and Justin Shun Wah of Bar Leone, opens on 25 November 2026 at the hotel on Salisbury Road in Tsim Sha Tsui.

The venue is designed as an Italian salotto, or living room, with mid-century wood finishes, mirrored walls and a colour scheme of gold, green and cream. It has about 50 seats across the indoor bar and an outdoor terrace overlooking Victoria Harbour.

Antinori and Shun Wah, whose Bar Leone has been ranked the world's best bar, said the concept aims for a relaxed gathering atmosphere rather than formal hotel-bar service. A signature feature is a trolley on which bartenders prepare Negronis at the table according to guest preferences.

The bar opens Tuesday to Sunday from 5pm, closing at midnight on weekdays and Sunday and at 1am on Friday and Saturday, with last orders shortly before closing. It is closed on Mondays. Reservations opened earlier in the month.

Hugo Montanari, managing director of Rosewood Hong Kong, described the collaboration as a shared vision between the hotel team and the Bar Leone founders. The hotel has ranked first in The World's 50 Best Hotels list.

zh.headline: 瑰麗酒店新酒吧Bar Camillo開業 由Bar Leone創辦人主理
zh.dek: 意大利風格雞尾酒吧於11月25日在尖沙咀酒店開始營業，設約50個室內及露台座位，並有桌邊調製尼格羅尼的手推車。
body: 瑰麗酒店表示，與Bar Leone創辦人Lorenzo Antinori及Justin Shun Wah合作的新雞尾酒吧Bar Camillo，於2026年11月25日在尖沙咀梳士巴利道的酒店開業。
酒吧以意大利客廳（salotto）為概念設計，採用二十世紀中期風格的木飾面、鏡牆，以及金色、綠色與米白色調。室內吧台及維港景露台合共約有50個座位。
Antinori及Shun Wah的Bar Leone曾獲世界最佳酒吧排名。他們表示，概念希望營造輕鬆聚會氣氛，而非傳統酒店酒吧的拘謹形式。特色之一是手推車，調酒師可按客人喜好在桌邊調製尼格羅尼。
酒吧星期二至星期日下午5時開門，平日及星期日午夜關門，星期五及星期六凌晨1時關門，最後點單時間略早於關門。星期一休息。預約已於本月較早時開放。
瑰麗酒店董事總經理Hugo Montanari形容這次合作是酒店團隊與Bar Leone創辦人的共同願景。該酒店曾名列世界50最佳酒店榜首。
